description:
Goal

Make request-local compiler products fresh by construction. A product is an immutable answer derived from exact named fact and product reads; transport publisher membership and contributions are products too. No seal, completion pass, epoch-wide rescan, downstream reconstruction, or parallel freshness cache is permitted.

Signal

- Cache-hit and missing reads both become durable dependencies.
- Waiting extends dependencies; a conclusion replaces them.
- Product generations advance only when immutable values change.
- Exact scheduler movements invalidate direct readers at the next demand; equal recomputation does not move ancestors.
- Forward and reverse schedules produce identical values, generations, dependencies, and transport relations.
- The representative three-drive transport test remains in or improves on its 15.52s-per-drive pre-change range.
- Full library tests and deny-warning clippy pass with no spike instrumentation.

Strategy

1. Give ProductMemo immutable entries, generations, exact dependencies, reverse reader indexes, and demand-local dirty propagation.
2. Route production reads through ProductReadContext. Remove product-specific revision stamps, direct unstamped reads, and DemandFactsCache.
3. Keep FactChange transitions inside Scheduler propagation. Export one FactMovement with the exact final FactState per moved key and deliver borrowed slices to the live ProductDriver. Coalesce only final states until demand; never infer finality from transition order or rescan World to reconstruct relevance.
4. Model shared executable facts as a product of authoritative upstream facts. Carrier classification reads intrinsic callsite mode from LoweredBody and publication evidence from its covering solve, removing optional MaterializedExecutable and global inventory reads from transport.
5. Treat every product named by one Waiting outcome as already requested in that atomic pull; servicing sibling waits cannot manufacture later frontier revisions. Model OutgoingEdgeFrontier(root) as the order-free requested publisher set and OutgoingInputEdges(publisher) as an immutable slot-to-source contribution. IncomingInputRelations(root) unions the exact frontier contributions once; IncomingInputSlot(slot) is a value-filtering projection of that immutable relation. Remove append-only session edge inventories and push invalidation compensation.
6. Keep the legacy solved closure only as an isolated owner of its side-produced layouts. Index its exact settled FactState consultations, boundary publications, and member ownership. Retract only closures related to a moved fact or runtime-demand product; preserve unrelated closures. Shape may project a layout only through a live owning cover.
7. Delete temporary probes, counters, stale comments, representation-inspection test APIs, and tests that pin removed concepts. Document the durable model.

Atomic boundary

Revisioned products alone exposed that append-only edge additions, repeated per-slot publisher scans, and whole-epoch closure clears repeatedly rebuilt or re-filtered large valid relations. The immutable frontier/contribution/relation model and targeted closure retraction are therefore part of this same commit: the intermediate states are not independently acceptable.

The closure solver itself remains legacy. This ticket does not introduce a closure product, publish fake component products, or replace the solver with raw position products. fz-k22.5 owns that refinement and the deletion of the remaining whole-closure inventory.

Acceptance

Permanent production-path tests cover dependency recording and replacement, exact final fact movement, readiness-only closure retraction, and transient cancellation, equal-value stability through three levels, SCC side publication, atomic frontier request lifecycle, outgoing replacement and withdrawal, incoming relation reuse, exact slot waits and no-edge publishers, order independence, live-cover ownership, and targeted closure retraction. Documentation matches the resulting contracts. The restored three-drive schedule test runs at 13.26s user per drive versus 15.52s before the change. cargo fmt --check, cargo test --lib, and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
title: Build revisioned products on exact outgoing and incoming transport facts
